name: Building Evacuation and Basic First Aid: Training Guide

sections.title: Before the shift
sections.excerpt: Walk the floor and check that every fire exit and stairwell door is clear and closes on its own.

sections.title: Know your floor
sections.excerpt: Keep an up-to-date list of who is on the floor, including visitors, for the headcount.

sections.title: After a drill
sections.excerpt: Write down how long the evacuation took and anything that slowed the group down.
